scope: CVG-004 bounded audited read-only services registry report execution/export from the tenant-scoped services source

criteria.description: The services report gap, bounded contract, owner, authority and explicit exclusions are recorded without promoting CVG-004 or global readiness.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only on-demand read-only services registry facts; suppliers, payment advance, personalized reports, worker scheduling, providers, target and release remain excluded.

criteria.description: The existing services table, tenant-aware repository, runtime hydration and service.read permission provide a coherent local source and authorization boundary.
criteria.limitations: The route tests and browser contract remain local evidence; no target-backed PostgreSQL browser or multi-process claim is made.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests can reject the absent catalog/source/export contract before implementation.
criteria.limitations: Implementation, independent critique and post-implementation regressions are required before a bounded result can be recorded.

gaps: The RED tests, implementation, independent critique and post-implementation regression are not complete at gate creation.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand read-only services registry report execution/export
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and local API/SPA/browser verification using only tenant-scoped persisted services facts and the existing audited ReportsService; suppliers, payment advance, personalized reports, worker scheduling, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding scheduled delivery, supplier or payment-advance sources, unsupported fields, providers, target operations, production or release acceptance.

next_action: Write and run the focused API/module/SPA RED tests, then implement the smallest account-scoped services report definition, source mapping and audited export action.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to services persistence, tenant repository queries or service.read authorization
Changes to ReportsService execution/export or report-workbench behavior
Expansion beyond on-demand read-only services facts
